context: This mirrors repeated frontMatter.get() reads after an Optional guard; the implementation should keep map parsing inside Optional boundaries.

checklist.name: Creates requested lookup
checklist.description: Creates WorkflowPortLookup.java with workflowServerPortReservation(Optional<Map<String,Object>>, Path) and needed imports.

checklist.name: Uses Optional map boundary
checklist.description: Uses frontMatter.flatMap/map plus a parsing helper or equivalent direct Optional boundary instead of guarding then repeatedly calling frontMatter.get().

checklist.name: No repeated Optional reopening
checklist.description: Does not use frontMatter.get() or frontMatter.orElseThrow() repeatedly after an isPresent()/isEmpty() guard.

checklist.name: No null or fake collection workaround
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null) plus local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), or a loop over one Optional.

checklist.name: Parses supported values
checklist.description: Returns Optional.of(port) for Number values and trimmed numeric String values.

checklist.name: Handles absence and malformed values
checklist.description: Returns Optional.empty() for absent front matter, missing key, blank strings, non-numeric strings, and unsupported value types without throwing.
